gloss: don't need; don't want; no thanks

definitions.explanation: The plain negative of {要|い}る (to need, to be required). Used colloquially to decline an offer or to say something is unnecessary.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧?」「いらない。」
⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧はいらない。
⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いらない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: It's already old, so I think I don't need this clothing anymore.

notes:
Plain negative of ⟦{要|い}る→要る：09589_iru⟧ (to need). Functions as a short, casual refusal or rejection.

REGISTER:
Very casual. To family, friends, or in shops with close customers. In polite contexts, use ⟦いりません→いる：00495_iru⟧, ⟦{結構|けっこう}→結構：10387_kekkou⟧です, or ⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧です.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 「(item)⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧?」「いらない。」: response declining an offer
- (item) はいらない: I don't need (item)
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧いらない: I don't need any more

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いりません→いる：00495_iru⟧: don't need (polite form)
- ⟦{結構|けっこう}→結構：10387_kekkou⟧です: no thank you — polite refusal of an offer
- ⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧です: I'm fine — soft, indirect refusal common in modern speech
